title: Highlight of our trip!
text: We had a lovely meal in a super setting. The outstanding  food worked so  well with tasting the wine. Roger brings wine to life and the choices of wine to taste, talk about and compare  were made perfectly. This was a highlight of our trip to Seville and we were a party of six but I can see this working well in slightly larger groups too.
author: Stelefalie

title: A wonderful evening
text: We had a wonderful evening with Roger who is an engaging host.  He selected some interesting and tasty wines, including some from his personal cellar. The food pairings were well selected and he talked us through each wine knowledgeably (with occasional maps).
author: madeleineb_12

title: Best Part of our Trip
text:
My husband and I took a trip to Seville with our other two friends. We were in Seville for 3 days and were interested in a wine tasting experience. We are very glad we found Roger and AQOT!
Unfortunately, the restaurant where the tasting and dinner are typically held was closed that day, but that actually turned out to be for the better! Instead Roger met us at our hotel and took us to 4 tapas places in the neighborhood and we tried wines, Iberian ham and tapas. author: Valerie A

title: Great evening!
text: Thank you Roger for spending the time with us. We learnt lots about Spanish wine/sherry and tapas paring. Good food, good wine & good company!
author: Christine R

title: Excellent Wine Tasting and Meal
text: My husband and I had a wonderful experience with Roger and A Question of Taste. He was clearly knowledgeable about Spanish wine, food, and culture. He helped explain the differences in Spanish wine versus others and brought pictures of wineries in Spain so that we could see exactly what he was referring to. The food pairing and dinner was excellent. The food items that he chose to pair with our wine were delicious and were the perfect foods to consume with the wine that we tasted.
